summary: Scheduled alerts firing due to pruned aggregate records after retention rewrite
description:
Issue summary:
Multiple scheduled alerts for AtlasLogs org started firing repeatedly for historical time windows after the retention-rewrite background compaction ran on 2026-03-11. Alerts reference metrics that should have been evicted; the alert evaluation engine appears to be seeing stale aggregate records that were temporarily left in a tombstoned state during the compact window.

Impact:
- Customer reports 40+ duplicate alert instances in a 2-hour window; paging fatigue for their on-call.
- Affected alerting channels: PagerDuty (critical), Slack #atlas-alerts (noise).
- Potential billing/usage impact due to spike in webhook deliveries.

Environment:
- Production cluster: prod-us-east
- Customer org: AtlasLogs Inc. (enterprise)
- Retention policy: 90d hot / 365d cold with background rewrite enabled (new retention-rewrite rollout v2.3.0)

Steps to reproduce (observed):
1. Run background retention rewrite on a shard containing high-cardinality aggregates (happened automatically 2026-03-11 02:05 UTC).
2. Wait for compaction job to mark old aggregates as pruned/evicted but while async index merge completes, run alert evaluation.
3. Alert evaluation queries older aggregates and receives records with tombstone markers; evaluator treats tombstones as present leading to false-positive condition matches.

Expected behavior:
- Compaction should either fully remove pruned aggregates before they are visible to the alert evaluation pipeline OR alert evaluation should ignore tombstoned/pruned records until merge completes.

Observed behavior:
- Alerts fired for historical windows referencing pruned aggregates, sometimes firing multiple times as index segments completed merging.

Logs & links:
- Atlas support bundle uploaded: s3://atlas-support/atlaslogs/2026-03-11/compact-incident-808080.tar.gz
- Alerting eval trace (sample): https://console.redwood.ai/trace/alerts/808080-eval
- Retention rewrite job: https://internal.redwood/jobs/rr-2026-03-11-0205
comments: 2026-03-12 09:07 - Lena Brooks (Support): Initial report received from customer. They attached PagerDuty alert flood screenshots and a support bundle. Escalating to SRE+Alerting team.

2026-03-12 11:30 - Marco Rivera (SRE): I can reproduce on a staging shard by running the retention-rewrite job and triggering scheduled-eval immediately while merge runs. Alerts appear when index segment has tombstoned documents but pre-merge metadata still surfaces values.

2026-03-13 08:45 - Priya Menon (Alerting): Hypothesis: alert-eval uses a read path that doesn't filter tombstone flags during compaction windows. Patch drafted to consult tombstone marker in query planner. Related PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metrics-service/pull/478
2026-03-13 15:10 - AtlasLogs (Customer): Confirmed they saw duplicate alerts clear after 3 hours. Asking for ETA on fix and whether a rollback of retention rewrite is necessary.

2026-03-14 10:20 - Marco Rivera (SRE): Temporary mitigation pushed: alerting pipeline will ignore data from shards marked 'compacting' for scheduled-eval for 1 hour post-compact by default. Patch deployed to canary. Monitoring for regressions.
2026-03-14 12:00 - Lena Brooks (Support): Notified customer of mitigation and asked them to confirm whether noise subsided. Added follow-up task to implement full fix in stable channel.
investigation_notes: Confirmed reproduce: running retention-rewrite + immediate scheduled-eval produces false positives in staging.
Root cause appears to be alert-eval's storage read path returning tombstoned aggregate rows while index-merge is incomplete; tombstone flag not respected by post-aggregation filter.
Observed multiple evaluation passes as segments finish merging, causing duplicate alert instances for the same condition window.
Related to retention-rewrite v2.3.0 which changed in-place segment marking behavior; previous release did full hard deletes before exposing new segment state.
Workaround implemented: alert-eval skip-window for shards with recent compaction activity (configurable).
resolution_notes: Mitigation: skip scheduled alert evaluations for shards with compaction timestamps < 1 hour (config flag). Long term: fix query planner to respect tombstone markers and update retention-rewrite to mark segments atomically. Backport planned to v2.2.x and v2.3.x. Patch PRs: metrics-service/pull/478 (read-path filter), console/pull/1221 (shielding UI duplicate alerts).
follow_up_tasks: ENG-2341: Implement tombstone-aware read path in metrics-service (priority P1)
OPS-1128: Add canary observability for compaction-alert interactions (dashboards + alert rules)
SUP-808081: Customer follow-up to confirm mitigation effectiveness and close ticket once noise subsides
